pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/PromptEvolutionView/usePromptEvolution.ts:132 The challenger gate (planStart/checkPairBlocks) refuses only a running test or text identical to the current incumbent. A rewrite that already lost a concluded A/B test can therefore be saved as a new variant and tested again, so the revision loop cycles instead of compounding.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/PromptEvolutionView/usePromptEvolution.ts:132 Concluded tests persist, but neither the gate nor the optimizer reads losing challengers, so the rejected diagnosis never reaches the reviser.

src/components/modules/evaluator/PromptEvolutionView/usePromptEvolution.ts:182 Adopting a procedure moves the active pointer over versioned variants (engine.restoreVariant -> setActiveVariant) and offers Undo, rather than overwriting the prompt.

pairs.evidence: src/app/api/prompt-evolution/route.ts:229 The prompt optimizer (the reviser) reads only module sessions and stats, never the concluded A/B tests its earlier challengers lost. On unchanged stats it deterministically re-proposes a rewrite that was already rejected.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/prompt-evolution/route.ts:229 The accumulated rejection record should be the reviser's input. optimizePrompt's signature has no access to concluded tests.
